question: What is the value of \[ \begin{aligned} &1 - (-2) - 3 - (-4) \\ &\quad {}- 5 - (-6)? \end{aligned} \]
solution:
Each parenthesized number is negative, so subtracting it adds its positive opposite. The expression becomes
\[
1+2-3+4-5+6.
\]
Grouping nearby terms gives
\[
(1+2)+(-3+4)+(-5+6)=3+1+1=\boxed{5}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
